In a complete cup every target-type support combination independently forms an accessible face signature; uniform type-support therefore makes every modal formula signature-determined by structural induction. Assumes the specific weak-Kleene partial-modal semantics and type-defining finite literals; finite enumeration alone is not all-depth proof.
